answer: Earned-reputation withholding: each identity starts at zero score, and payouts split by score share, so a clone dilutes its own earnings. New identities also post a zephyr-light deposit that unlocks only after 30 days of settled work; early exit forfeits it. Cloning costs that deposit plus lost yield per copy, while the marginal clone earns less than its share—making each extra identity strictly negative-EV. Reputation pigment accumulates only on the original, and a sable flag marks linked clones.
